capabilities: Sync the vault two-way with a GitHub repo on a background timer
Resolve merge conflicts automatically with AI, with a three-pane fallback UI
Diagnose and navigate git errors like non-fast-forward pushes
Draft semantic commit messages from diffs using DeepSeek or Gemini
Browse per-file commit history with inline diffs
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is available in multiple languages (English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese). Credentials are designed to stay out of the repo via .obsidian/ storage and a token-free .github-sync.json schema.
problem: Obsidian users who don't know git have no easy way to keep their vault synced with GitHub when branches diverge or pushes fail.

relations.evidence: A GitHub two-way sync plugin for Obsidian users who don't know git.
DeepSeek or Gemini reads the diff and produces a semantic message
DeepSeek or Gemini reads the diff and produces a semantic message

requires.name: GitHub Personal Access Token (alternative to GitHub App)

summary: Git-based two-way sync plugin that uses an AI agent to resolve merge conflicts, diagnose git errors, and draft commit messages for GitHub backups.
